description: This file defines data models, enums, translation maps, and utility functions related to rate limits in the Thingsboard project, specifically for tenant and device rate limiting configurations.

methods.name: stringToRateLimitsArray
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string of rate limits into an array of RateLimits objects.

methods.name: rateLimitsArrayToString
methods.description: Serializes an array of RateLimits objects into a string format.

methods.name: rateLimitsArrayToHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML representation of rate limits array with translation support.

methods.name: rateLimitsToHtml
methods.description: Creates HTML snippet for a single RateLimits object with translation support.
